newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Indal, Japan firm in joint venture talk.
newsitem.headline: Indal, Japan firm in joint venture talk.

text.p: A small-scale Indonesian alumunium product manufacturer PT Indal Alumunium Industry said on Friday it was planning a joint venture with a Japanese firm.

"Yes, we are in talks with a Japanese firm to form a joint venture firm to produce alumunium products, but I can't give you further details as the talks are still going on," corporate secretary Sugiarto told Reuters declining to elaborate.

Indal closed 250 rupiah higher at 1,725 rupiah, with some 1.5 million shares traded, on Friday surpassing its previous record of 1,575 rupiah in July 15. It touched a year low of 825 rupiah on April 7.
Brokers said the sharp rise was due to market talk of a possible joint venture.
